mechs: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for an original top-down industrial mech survival game, Factorio-like pre-rendered gritty sprites, NOT vector graphics or flat cartoon. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows in a square 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Equal 256x256 cells with generous transparent padding, no grid or text. Orthographic near-overhead camera, every unit faces UP toward top edge, consistent camera/light from upper left. Rows 1,2,3 are three distinct heavy biped robot designs: row1 agile olive steel scout with small amber cockpit and twin machine guns; row2 bulky rust ochre siege mech with broad shoulders and armored shotgun arm; row3 compact gray-blue reactor mech with turquoise coils and a plasma cannon. Row4 is an alien organic nest, four pulsating animation frames, dark chitin and amber sacs. Each row has FOUR WALK CYCLE FRAMES of the SAME design: left foot forward, neutral, right foot forward, neutral; body placement and scale identical across the row, feet move clearly. Nest row pulses. Detailed worn armor, rivets, pistons, cables, chipped metal, restrained highlights, no neon outline. Feet and legs are clearly visible from above. Unit centered within each cell occupying 65-75% cell height, no clipping, no ground, no baked large shadow, genuine alpha transparency. All original designs, no branding, no lettering, no watermarks.
bugs: Use case: stylized-concept. Game-ready raster sprite animation sheet for an original Factorio-like gritty alien insect survival game. Exactly FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows on a square transparent canvas, equal cells, no grid, no labels. Orthographic high-angle overhead sprites, creatures face DOWN toward bottom edge consistently, no perspective ground. Four WALK CYCLE poses per row: alternating left and right legs stepping, preserve exact body design and same scale and center. Row1 small six-legged olive tan chitin hunter with sharp mandibles; row2 green acid spitter beetle with bulbous translucent abdomen and pale venom sacs; row3 broad rust crimson armored rhino beetle with huge forward horns and thick carapace; row4 massive dark violet queen insect, long segmented armored body, six hooked legs, amber sacs, elaborate crown-like horns. Dense pre-rendered 3D sprite look, worn natural shell, organic joints, restrained muted earth colors, readable silhouette at small size. Light from upper left, gentle contact shadow only. Every subject fully contained inside its cell with 12% transparent margin on all sides; no overlaps. Real alpha background. Original designs, no brands, no text, no neon lines, no cartoon outlines.
ground: Use case: stylized-concept. A single seamless tileable top-down ground texture for a Factorio-like industrial alien planet video game. Square texture, fills entire canvas edge to edge. Orthographic perfectly overhead view of dark desaturated ash-brown compacted dirt, fine gravel, subtle rusty mineral flecks, a few tiny flat pebbles, faint tire impressions and naturally cracked dry clay. Detailed pre-rendered raster game texture with low contrast so small units remain readable over it. Entire surface even soft diffuse lighting, no directional shadow, no horizon, no vignette, no large objects, no buildings, no text or symbols, no neon, no obvious central motif. Edges designed to tile seamlessly horizontally and vertically. Restrained charcoal olive-gray and brown industrial wasteland palette, not black, not colorful.
